name: No Restrictions on Fog of Doom Conversions
description: **Needs "Fog of Doom Lets Every Heathen Listen": ticking this patch ticks it too, and unticking that one unticks this one.** No restrictions on Fog of Doom Conversions: red and yellow heathens can be talked to, and the -10 faith limit requiring Earthquakes is removed. Those heathens can now be talked to like any other blue heathen and eventually converted, as long as Fog of Doom is active. ("Yellow" is the game's orange mask.) Natural fog and every other weather still do nothing; the listening, the Faith it gives and the conversion are the normal game's, as for a blue-masked Heathen. **Off by default.** **Not yet seen in a running game** (checked by emulation of the stock executable). The patch adds one small file, "VVFP Fog Listening No Restrictions.txt", to the patcher's folder, which tells "VVFP Fog Listening.dll" to leave out the Faith limit.
behavior_changes: With its file "VVFP Fog Listening No Restrictions.txt" in the patcher's folder when the game starts, "VVFP Fog Listening.dll" (read once, at its VvfpStartup) leaves out the Faith condition: a Heathen in the orange or red mask takes the stock listening path 0x443D65 whenever the game's thick-fog test 0x476260 answers yes, whatever their Faith (+0x1CF0).
explicit_non_changes: Natural fog, a Tempest and every other weather still never count: the thick-fog test is unchanged.
The work event 0x468DA0 (roles 12-17, the 2-hour wait, the Devotion check, Faith +3 to +5) and the conversion are the game's own; the Earthquake is unchanged.
No code of its own and no executable byte: the file is all the row ships.
